mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: I've been watching, you're doing well.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Once you close the shop for the day...

nextDialogue.plainText: You should have time to go outside before going to sleep.

nextDialogue.plainText: You still remember the way to the Dumping Grounds right?

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor

mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, just dropping by to see your first day.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor

nextDialogue.plainText: Listen, I got this for you

nextDialogue.plainText: *He pulls some notes from his jacket pocket and places them on the counter.*

nextDialogue.plainText: Just some things I wouldn't want you to forget.

mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: I've got some useful information for you.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Word is that a mining expedition is coming back tomorrow...

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: So the market will be flush with Materials.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Prices will fall, for a while, while supply outweighs demand.

mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: I just came from the Docks...

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: A shipment of counterfeit cigarettes just got unloaded.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: You might start seeing them in circulation.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: I brought you some stuff to help identify fakes.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Use the Magnifying Glass on the Cigarette Box to Examine it.

mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: Well. I taught you all the basics.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: The rest is up to you now.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Remember to buy upgrades, new machines, and expand your contacts.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Once you have more Credits, you can either find someone to offer you a mortgage,

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: or buy out the store directly, if you got enough.

mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, If you haven't noticed, there's a display case on your left.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Place merchandise inside the display case to attract a specific type of buyer to your shop.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Place special items like Neon Signs inside the display case to attract sellers. Here, take these.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Place them inside the display case and check the Clientele Interface to see who might come. Make sure to set up your display case before opening the shutter door.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Make sure it's all set before you open the shutter door.

mainDialogue.title: The Mentor
mainDialogue.plainText: Say, I noticed your display case is still looking a little empty.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: The neon sign will attract sellers.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: The merchandise will attract buyers.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: The more a specific type of goods is worth in your case, the richer the customers it pulls in.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: You should always have both on display.

nextDialogue.title: Joe Wild
